assistant.$description: Tokens for the AI Assistant (launcher, connecting bar, panel, conversation). Measured from the reference product's public CSS (--ref-ai-* custom properties, read 2026-10-09 without opening the chat) and themed for AcmeCo (decision 29).

start.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED, PROPOSED: the reference product's AI gradient starts at its green #04b69a; AcmeCo's starts at navy (decision 29).

end.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED, PROPOSED: the reference product's ends at #0f7e07; AcmeCo's at the link blue.

text.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: white text on the filled accent (Voice Mode on). 12.6:1 on navy, 6.80:1 on blue.

light.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED, PROPOSED: the moving edge while connecting (the reference product: cyan, aqua, mint, lime); AcmeCo: link blue, light blue, navy. Decorative.

duration.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: the gradient slides back and forth over 4s (orbit-gradient-div). Stops for reduced motion. Code only.

glow.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED, PROPOSED: the soft glow around the bar and panel, in blue.

radius.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 100px pill. Floats over the page (decision 26).

height-md.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 2.5rem on results and listing pages.

height-lg.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 48px on the homepage (56px on the desktop homepage; 48px kept as one size).

padding-end.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 8px (the icon sits close to the end).

font-weight.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: bold label (the legacy brand typeface Bold); semibold Outfit (decision 4).

width.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 27.5rem bar on results pages (--ref-ai-srp-bar-width); the panel uses the same width.

radius.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 6.25rem pill. Floats over the page (decision 26).

shadow.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 0 6px 16px 2px at 16% black (--ref-ai-shadow-elevated); became the raised shadow dialogs use.

gap.$description: PROPOSED: 12px between conversation, text box and controls.

conversation-max-height.$description: PROPOSED: the conversation scrolls above this height; expand for more room.

expanded-height.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED, PROPOSED: expanded, the reference product's panel grows to most of the window's height (a reference screenshot); 640px, never taller than the window.

header-height.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 3rem header in the expanded panel (--ref-ai-chat-header-height).

header-line.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: a 3px gradient line under the header (--ref-ai-chat-header-underline-height). Decorative.

divider.$description: PROPOSED: a line above the pinned text box in the expanded panel (the reference product shows a soft band there). Decorative.

user-background.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: #f5f5f5 user bubble (--ref-ai-bg-user-bubble); AcmeCo's subtle grey #f3f3f3.

user-max-width.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: user bubbles at most 75% of the width (--ref-ai-user-bubble-max-width).

color.$description: PROPOSED: grey dots in the panel (the reference product's are white with a shadow, over photos). Decorative: 'Thinking' is announced as text.

duration.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 1.2s bounce. Stops for reduced motion. Code only.

height.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 2rem Voice Mode pill; the same height as Button sm.

radius.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 6.25rem pill; became 4px, something you act on (decision 26, decision 29).

padding-x.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 8px; became 12px to match Button sm.

border.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: #d2d2d2 outline (1.5:1); became the 3:1 control border (decision 5).

icon-size.$description: REFERENCE-OBSERVED: 1.25rem icon; became 16px, the Button sm icon size.
